user.title: F-LINX Garage Door
user.description: Enter your F-LINX cloud credentials. Real-time state is delivered via MQTT; commands are sent locally over Bluetooth.

select_device.title: Select garage door
select_device.description: Your account has multiple doors. Choose which one to add.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to F-LINX API
error.no_devices: No devices found on this account

init.title: F-LINX Garage Door options
init.description: MQTT push is the primary state source. Optionally poll the cloud API on a fixed schedule to recover state that MQTT silently drops (e.g. when the door is operated by a physical remote).

refresh_state.name: Refresh state
refresh_state.description: Force an immediate state read from the F-LINX cloud API, bypassing MQTT. Useful in automations when MQTT push updates are unreliable.
